//: gh-collab configuration for this repository. Format and defaults: config.md beside this file. Machine-specific values (gate commands with local caps, worker id) go in <git common dir>/gh-collab/config.json, never here: this file is public.

setup: `just wasm-tools`, if wasm-bindgen-cli, wasmtime or cargo-nextest is missing
read the Conventions section of the plan set's `README.md` once
rules: Follow the repository's `.claude/CLAUDE.md` and `.claude/rules/`. For a plan task, use the `implement-task` skill with its ID.

Before each commit and before the gate, run `git fetch origin`. If `origin/rendering-and-planets` moved, run `git merge --no-edit origin/rendering-and-planets`: never rebase, resolve conflicts keeping both sides' intent, and regenerate generated files rather than merging them by hand.

Accuracy first: every physical constant, model parameter and fitted figure carries its source in its doc comment, checked against that source when written. Never silently drop a species: label what is not modelled.

Record and defer: a finding that leaves the algorithm and every contract unchanged goes in the plan's Risks under "Deferred findings (2026-10-13 rule)" and one line of the report; then keep building. A question that would change the algorithm or a contract goes on this issue with your lean, through the work-issue skill's `comment` step; make the smallest reversible choice, record it, and build what doesn't depend on it.
Run the `review-changes` skill before committing. Fix must-fix and should-fix findings, or say why not.
One commit for the task, plus at most one for review fixes. Never `--no-verify` on a commit: the 500 kB added-file hook is the owner's rule.
Never use `git stash`: worktrees share one stash.
Cross-platform: the code builds and runs on Linux, macOS and Windows, or states its limit.
report: the branch, its commit hashes, and the `origin/rendering-and-planets` commit it was last merged with
the gate's planned steps and its log's last line
deviations, as recorded in the plan
deferred findings, one line each, and any open question with your lean
